base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: the same cosy circular copper kitchen-laboratory, now crowded and cheerful, the mirror-polished table laid for dinner, squirrels perched on shelves and in Marvel's hat. Lighting: warm golden lamplight, the lighthouse beam sweeping past the windows.
In the shot: Princess Holly, a tiny fairy princess about the height of a teacup, with a shimmering fairy-pink dress, iridescent wings like soap bubbles that catch the light, a little silver tiara, rosy cheeks, and a slender wand that fizzes with small irregular pink sparks; Ben Elf, a tiny elf about the height of a teacup, neat and bright-eyed, wearing a pointed green hat, a green jacket with eleven unnecessary pockets, and a belt hung with a small brass horn, a spare horn, a scroll, a magnifying glass, a bag of mixed nuts and a laminated official ID card; Tomkin, an anthropomorphic tabby cat who walks upright, slim and wiry, with burnt-orange "artisanal copper" fur and darker copper tiger stripes, bright emerald-green eyes, long expressive whiskers, a smug confident half-smile, brass welding goggles pushed up on his forehead, and a leather tool belt full of tiny gadgets.
Camera: Quick comic shot-reverse-shots.
Action: Holly flutters up hopefully beside Tomkin's ice cream; Tomkin doesn't even look up.
Dialogue: Princess Holly (soft, sweet, gentle young female voice, kind and nervous, apologising quickly, words tumbling out, hopeful) says: "Could I have a tiny bit of the ice cream? Just the mint part?" Tomkin (crisp, rapid-fire, precise male tenor with a clipped British accent; superior, exasperated, always certain he is the only rational being in the room, flat) says: "No."
Sound effects: spoon clink, ambience of cosy crackle, distant waves, contented chatter.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
